quests.name: Unpaid Balance
quests.summary: You woke owing Aurelian 48,000 credits and missing six weeks of your life. Your own handwriting points at a place called Platform Nine.

stages.text: Forty-eight thousand credits, no memory of borrowing them, and a pillow slit open by someone who meant you to find it. Search your capsule.
A receipt chip in your own handwriting, with a note: 'Platform Nine'. Somebody who knows tech or medicine can read the code.
stages.objective: Find someone who can read the receipt chip

stages.text: The chip puts your stolen memory in a vault at Platform Nine, in the drowned metro under the flooded streets. The vault is sealed.
stages.objective: Get through the vault door at Platform Nine

stages.text: The vault is open. Somebody is waiting inside with a repo collar and a very polite smile.

quests.name: Tomas's Lease
quests.summary: Ren's brother lives on an Aurelian-leased respirator whose fee keeps rising. She needs an override chip from a wrecked service van in the flooded streets.

stages.text: Ren says an Aurelian service van crashed in the flooded streets last month, and its lockbox may still hold the lease override.
stages.objective: Find the lease override chip in the flooded streets

stages.text: You hold a chip that can free Tomas's respirator from the Spire's lock. Dr. Halvorsen can fit it.
stages.objective: Take the chip to Dr. Halvorsen at the clinic

quests.name: Lanterns on the Line
quests.summary: Aurelian drones are nesting in the flooded streets and mapping Saint hideouts. Dagny wants three of them dead.

stages.text: A nest of Aurelian scout drones in the flooded streets is mapping Saint turf. Dagny wants it burned out.
The drones lie in the black water. Dagny will want to hear it from you.
stages.objective: Tell Dagny at the Wet Circuit
